name: pi-change-workspace
description: Switch the workspace of a running native Windows Pi CLI session: choose a folder with Windows' own dialog and continue in a fresh blank session for that folder, in the same Pi process and TUI.

scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-isolation=none test/target-path.test.mjs test/picker.test.mjs test/session-target.test.mjs test/command.test.mjs test/register.test.mjs test/autocomplete.test.mjs test/entry.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint:syntax && npm run test:unit
